description: This file defines the IMediaPipelineClient interface, an abstract class for media pipeline clients to receive notifications about media playback events such as duration, position, native size, network state, playback state, media data availability, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for media pipeline clients to receive notifications about media playback events.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify the client of the total duration of the media in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the client of the current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the client of the native size and aspect ratio of the video.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify the client of the current network state.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify the client of the current playback state.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify the client whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify the client whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client that media data is needed, including source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client to cancel any outstanding media data request for a specific source.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify the client of a QoS update from the player.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify the client that a buffer underflow has occurred for a specific source.
